_comment: Smoke eval round 2026-Q3-smoke: 9 representative cases, one per locale pack. Edit this list to add / swap cases. Run `python3 build.py` to regenerate stub JSONL files for all listed models.

cases.rationale: Reference locale. Natural Taiwan conversation that exercises the standard zh-TW layer.
cases.notes: Baseline. If this fails, the entire zh-TW layer is broken.

cases.rationale: Mainland 小红书 lifestyle channel — exercises zh-cn style profile + glossary.
cases.notes: First zh-CN case in the v1.1.0 expansion. Channel-specific style profile.

cases.rationale: HK WhatsApp colloquial — Cantonese 口語 handling.
cases.notes: First v1.2.0 new locale. Verifies the LANGUAGE_FILES wiring.

cases.rationale: US LinkedIn post — exercises en-us style profile + spelling.
UK formal letter — strict_precision legal register.
cases.notes: Router auto-escalates to strict_precision for legal context.

cases.rationale: Japanese formal email (keigo) — exercises sonkeigo / kenjōgo / teineigo.
cases.notes: Keigo correctness is the highest-leverage Japanese signal.

cases.rationale: Korean formal business email — 합쇼체 register.
cases.notes: Register leak (합쇼체 vs 해요체 vs 반말체).

cases.rationale: Indonesian WhatsApp casual — informal register with emoji.
Vietnamese Zalo casual — diacritics + casual particles.
cases.notes: Missing diacritics is the most common vi-VN failure mode.
